name: Muddy Creek Raceway

soil.notes: Hard clay base with large amounts of mulch, wood chips and water worked in. Pro previews describe it as very tacky in one corner and rock-hard, slick clay in the next; tilled before a moto it is among the best dirt in the country. Directories simply call it loamy.

layout.notes: Natural-terrain hillside layout. The tight 180 first turn at the top of the hill is known for pileups.

conditions.dry: Where mulch blows off, the base clay goes hard and shiny with little grip; stay in the softer dirt.
conditions.wet: Clay does not absorb heavy rain well; expect puddles and very sticky mud. Recent Top Gun events (Oct 2026) ran in mud.
conditions.watering_prep: Heavy watering and disking with mulch; pro events started a bit muddy to keep moisture deep. Later years managed moisture more evenly.
conditions.seasonal: Event weekends only (Victory Sports): THOR Mega Series, Tennessee State Championship, Hot Summer Nights, Top Gun Showdown in October. Pro national 2013-2018.

rider_reports.says: Preview: dirt is sticky in one turn and rock-hard clay in the next; superb when tilled; often muddy for practice, then ruts harden as it dries.
Race observer called 2015 the best version yet: some rain, shallow ruts, good traction; narrow spots and a sketchy first turn.
Preview: hard clay plus mulch and water gives great traction, but shiny bare clay on hillside berms has almost no grip.
With a storm coming, writer warned the slick clay does not soak up heavy rain and turns to puddles and sticky mud.
Writer recalls amateur years there: mulch-heavy dirt was good prep for Loretta's; moisture now managed more evenly; uphill first-turn 180 known for pileups.
D-class rider at the 2025 Top Gun Showdown describes deep ruts, big jumps and rough terrain.
2026 Top Gun Showdown race video titled around mud carnage.
Rider recommends racing it every chance you get.

name: Loretta Lynn's Ranch
address: 44 Hurricane Mills Rd, Hurricane Mills, TN 37078

soil.notes: Loamy river-bottom soil with sawdust/mulch and sand worked in by the prep crew before each national.

layout.notes: Riders say the layout is easy to learn but the rough, rutted conditions make it very technical.

conditions.dry: Hot and humid early August; track gets very rough and rutted through the week.
conditions.wet: Summer storms have turned it into a muddy mess and forced rain delays (2013, 2023).
conditions.watering_prep: Prepped like a national: sand and mulch mixed in, ripped deep to hold moisture, watered on schedule. Fresh mulch can make odd bumps until mixed in.
conditions.seasonal: Closed to practice all year; used only for the AMA Amateur National (early August) and ATV national.

rider_reports.says: Vet racer: prep is excellent, with sand and mulch mixed and ripped deep; track gets very rough and rutted and is highly technical.
Summer storms caused long delays and turned the track muddy after a hot, rough practice week.
Day one ended with a heavy downpour leaving the track a muddy mess.
Crew adds sawdust and sand to loamy river-bottom soil; track is grass the rest of the year.
Open to spectators; poster called it nice.
